theorems.name: Submission.cmcdtfrbvbsf_closed_faces_isCompact
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (s : Finset ((Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ))), IsCompact {x : Euclid P | ∃ q ∈ s, ∃ y : Euclid (m + 1), (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (q.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (q.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) = x}
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
